name: Sapindus

project_scope.selection_mode: canonical S. drummondii + B142 source reconciliation
project_scope.note: Western soapberry is canonical Sapindus drummondii. Older var./subsp. drummondii names and a typographic duplicate map to that learner. Sapindus saponaria s.s. remains separate and requires strict taxonomy/range review before any Texas-native treatment.

study_strategy.warning: Do not treat every Texas record labeled Sapindus saponaria as S. saponaria sensu stricto. Older broad treatments can include western soapberry now handled as S. drummondii.

quick_comparison: S. drummondii — canonical western soapberry; older S. saponaria var./subsp. drummondii names map here.
S. saponaria s.s. — separate concept awaiting strict taxonomy/range review; Hays-local source cannot be trusted until the old broad-name usage is reconciled.
